description: Animation tables of the story characters in the cutscenes of map0_s00 (Old Silent Hill - intro sequence). A cutscene asks whether a character's animation is done ("playback") and which keyframe it starts at ("start_keyframe"; the same tables as playback when absent); the answer comes from the table named here, a file gamedata/tables/anim/<table>.json indexed by the character's animation status. "tables" maps a character name to its table and "fallback" is the table of every character not listed (none: such a character has no table). On this map, playback: every character uses "cheryl". Sounds that an animation keyframe cues play at volume 128 (no "cue_sounds" here). Read when the map loads.
